data.body:
Fix pushed as Gerrit change 2557 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2557), from a worktree at current gerrit/main.

Reproduced on PRISTINE gerrit/main before changing anything — 1 failed, 5 passed — so this is a main breakage and not something change 2555 introduced. 2555 (F10) is only its first visible victim; every change branched from main inherits it.

AC1: the assertion now reads the VALUE ("bug" in _PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES) rather than matching source text.
AC2: removing "bug" from the exemption set in rebar.types turns it RED.
AC3: re-pointing the gates.py alias — a behaviour-preserving move — keeps it GREEN. That pair is the exact inversion of the old assertion, which went red on the refactor and would have stayed green on a value change.
AC4: the other five tests in the file are untouched; 7 pass in the file.

One correction during implementation. My first draft added a second test calling _plan_review_gate_applies to assert a bug is not review-required. That predicate consults gate_enabled, so a bug would read "not required" whenever the gate is simply switched OFF — the test would have passed for a reason unrelated to the exemption. Replaced with a config-independent complement assertion: bug exempt while story and task are not, which also stops the first assertion passing by the set growing to cover everything.

Gates: make lint and make typecheck clean; 1458 passed / 4 skipped in tests/unit -k "gates or claim or plan_review".

No production behaviour changes — this is a test-only fix.
